name: facl
description: Firebase-style access-control rules for HTTP APIs, powered by a Rust engine compiled to WebAssembly
author: Chisomo Makombo Sakala

scripts.build: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p facl-wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir wasm ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/facl_wasm.wasm
